publicScopeValueType.status: Present in the isolated prototype as one immutable public value object required to supply the same caller scope through CascadingValue and DialogConfigurator.SetThemeScope; not approved as a released public API name or shape.
publicScopeValueType.whyPublic: A consumer must be able to construct a strongly typed value for the public builder method and Blazor CascadingValue. Making the type internal would make the public method unusable and the cascade contract untyped.
